messages:
sara_marketing: Quick sync — last-minute microcopy & credit routing for the May webinar cohort. Need final text for the 2 nudges and the route config before we flip the experiment on tomorrow.

javier_growth: Ack. I pushed the cohort segmentation spreadsheet to the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/webinar-may-cohorts — main thing: separate trial users vs existing users. Trial users get 75 credits, existing get 25.

elaine_pd: For microcopy — propose A/B: A = 'Start building with 75 starter credits' B = 'Get 75 credits to try Redwood in minutes' — both with CTA 'Activate credits'. Which reads better for dev audiences?

javier_growth: I prefer B for devs, more action-oriented. Also recommend a secondary line for onboarding: 'Use our prompt templates to ship faster'

mike_eng: Routing note — we'll route by signup_source param. Suggested rule: if signup_source=="webinar_may" AND is_new_account then apply promo_75 else promo_25. Config below:```json
{"route":"/signup","conditions":[{"param":"signup_source","op":"eq","value":"webinar_may"},{"field":"account_age_days","op":"lt","value":7}],"promo":"promo_75"}```

nina_ops: Sounds good. Two ops asks: 1) ensure quota enforcement on promo_75 to prevent accidental drain, 2) add alert if redemptions > 5k/day.

mike_eng: Will add quota cap (100k tokens total across promo) and alert rule. I'll push the feature flag to staging now. Expect a staging deploy log in ~10m.

webhook-bot: staging-deploy: deploy-1867 succeeded on infra-staging (sha 4a9f2b).

elaine_pd: Microcopy final: Headline = 'Get 75 credits to try Redwood in minutes' Subhead = 'Use starter prompts to integrate LLM features in under an hour.' CTA = 'Activate credits' — i'll add icons for copy.

javier_growth: Can we add a lightweight experiment metric: % who open prompt-templates page within 24h of activation? Want to prove product-led motion.

mike_eng: I'll emit an event `credits_activated` and `templates_viewed` with user_id and cohort tag. Growth can query in Looker.

nina_ops: Also routing update — confirm the fallback: if promo_75 quota exhausted, fall back to promo_25 and increment a `promo_fallback` metric.

mike_eng: Done. Fallback logic in the rules engine and metric wired up.

javier_growth: Sweet. Action items: Elaine finalize assets by EOD, Mike finish staging->prod rollout and docs, Nina set alerts, Sara coordinate launch post copy with comms.

sara_marketing: I'll draft the launch post and benchmark blurb (latency/cost narrative) and share for edits. Thanks team :rocket:
